# tilelang 0.1.9 — locally built wheel (see docs/dsv4/tilelang_build.md).
# Needed for the V4 sparse_attn_kernel path in dsv4/tilelang_kernels.py.
# pypi publishes only manylinux_2_34_aarch64 wheels for 0.1.7+, which
# don't run on this host's glibc 2.32; the bundled-TVM 0.1.6.post2 wheel
# clashes with flashinfer's apache-tvm-ffi at the shared static-index
# table.  Our 0.1.9 source build shares apache-tvm-ffi cleanly.
https://rtp-maga.cn-zhangjiakou.oss.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/tilelang-0.1.9%2Bcuda.git441c3b06-cp38-abi3-linux_aarch64.whl
# z3-solver — tilelang imports z3 at JIT time.  The upstream aarch64
# wheels' libz3.so needs glibc 2.34 (this host has 2.32); repackaged
# with a locally-built libz3.so linking against the system glibc.
# Source build: see docs/dsv4/tilelang_build.md §z3.
https://rtp-maga.cn-zhangjiakou.oss.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/z3_solver-4.13.0.0%2Blocal.ali-py2.py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl
# tile_kernels — pure-Python wrappers over tilelang for V4 mhc/moe/quant
# kernels (https://github.com/deepseek-ai/TileKernels @ 36d9e45).  Needed
# for the dsv4 mhc_post fused TileLang kernel (block.py:_use_tk_mhc_post);
# without it that path falls back to a slower BMM rewrite AND smoke
# goldens diverge.  No PyPI release; locally-built wheel hosted on OSS.
# See docs/dsv4/prefill_opt/plan_0427.md P0 section.
https://search-ad.oss-cn-hangzhou-zmf-internal.aliyuncs.com/rtp-llm-deps/arm_pkg/tile_kernels-0.1.dev0%2Bali.git36d9e45-py3-none-any.whl
